title: Time-effect of FEST+TST in the Upper-extremity Rehabilitation of Individuals with Traumatic SCI
official: Time Sensitivity of Adaptive Neuroplasticity and Functional Recovery Related to FEST in Combination with TST for Rehabilitation of Upper Extremity Function of Individuals with Tetraplegia
summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate whether the timing of delivery of functional electrical stimulation therapy in combination with task-specific training (FEST+TST) following spinal cord injury (SCI) influences functional and neurological recovery.

interventions.name: FES Therapy combined with task-specific training (FEST+TST)
